description: This file defines the class ConfigXmlBuilder, a utility for building configuration XML documents for OpenMRS modules in testing scenarios. It provides a fluent API to construct various elements of the XML, including module metadata, dependencies, filters, servlets, and conditional resources, conforming to a specified DTD version.

classes.name: ConfigXmlBuilder
classes.description: Main class for constructing XML configuration documents for OpenMRS modules in testing.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the 'id' element in the XML.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Sets the 'name' element in the XML.

methods.name: withVersion
methods.description: Sets the 'version' element.

methods.name: withPackage
methods.description: Sets the 'package' element.

methods.name: withAuthor
methods.description: Sets the 'author' element.

methods.name: withDescription
methods.description: Sets the 'description' element.

methods.name: withActivator
methods.description: Sets the 'activator' element.

methods.name: withUpdateUrl
methods.description: Sets the 'updateURL' element.

methods.name: withRequireVersion
methods.description: Sets the 'require_version' element.

methods.name: withRequireDatabaseVersion
methods.description: Sets the 'require_database_version' element.

methods.name: withMappingFiles
methods.description: Sets the 'mappingFiles' element.

methods.name: withMandatory
methods.description: Sets the 'mandatory' element.

methods.name: withPackagesWithMappedClasses
methods.description: Sets the 'packagesWithMappedClasses' element.

methods.name: withPrivilege

methods.name: withGlobalProperty

methods.name: withServlet

methods.name: withMessages

methods.name: withFilter
methods.description: Adds a 'filter' element with optional name, class, and init-params.

methods.name: withFilterMapping
methods.description: Adds a 'filter-mapping' element with optional filter name, URL pattern, and servlet name.

methods.name: withConditionalResources
methods.description: Adds 'conditionalResources' with nested 'conditionalResource' elements.

methods.description: Returns the constructed Document object.
